how_its_made:
One of the most significant challenges I faced during the development of this project was maintaining a decentralized mapping system. This issue was crucial because the core functionality of the project hinged on the ability to accurately and securely map user identities in a decentralized environment.

To tackle this challenge, I turned to Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs) as a novel solution. NFTs are unique digital assets that are verified on a blockchain, making them tamper-proof and easily verifiable. By leveraging the inherent properties of NFTs, I was able to create a robust mapping system.
